description: Ireland's Environmental Protection Agency publishes the national Pollutant Release and Transfer Register, which gives key environmental data for industrial facilities: over 400 sites engaged in activities that can harm the environment, with their releases to air, water and land from 2007 to 2021. The register covers 91 key pollutants, among them heavy metals, pesticides, greenhouse gases and dioxins, and it puts the UNECE PRTR Protocol under the Aarhus Convention into practice. The data.gov.ie record offers a zipped Shapefile and HTML resources, free under CC-BY-4.0, and was last modified on 23 June 2023. Coverage is national at facility level with annual values, and the record lists the update frequency as other. Caveats: only reporting facilities above thresholds are included, values are self-reported and the series ends in 2021. It suits hazard exposure and industrial siting studies, for example flood or fire exposure of chemical facilities, and industrial emission inputs to regional models. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
